full_judgment:
That one Jion Box was owner of 0'58 acres land of CS plot No. 5159 and 0'20 acres of CS plot No. 5159/5351 in all 0'78 acres of CS Khatian No. 1704 of Mouja Matuail including other lands; that said Jion Box died leaving one sons Sayedur Rahman, 4 daughters Alesa Khatun, Khairer Nessa, Kulsum Bibi and Anwara Begum; that by amicable partition with sisters Sayedur Rahman became absolute owner and was in exclusive possession in said 0.78 acres land and accordingly it was recorded in his name in SA Khatian No. 2034; that 0.58 acres land of CS and SA plot No. 5159 was recorded in RS plot No. 7460 and 0'20 acres land of CS and SA plot No. 5159/5351 was recorded in RS plot No. 7459 in RS Khatian No. 1467 in the name of said Sayedur Rahman. There was partition deed No. 2478 dated 9-3-1979 between Sayedur Rahman and his sisters. As per said partition deed, Khairer Nessa and Alesa Khatun got other lands which they sold to others by registered Saf-Kabola. Being exclusive and absolute owner and in exclusive possession in aforesaid 0.78 acres Sayedur Rahman sold 0.15 acres of said 2 plots to respondent No. 1 vide registered Saf-Kabola No. 6265 dated 12-11-1980 and also sold 0.15 acres on the same date vide registered Khatian No. 6266 to Md Abdullah father of respondent No. 1 and delivered possession of it. Out of said purchased 0.30 acres 10 acres are in the Southern side of CS and SA plot No. 5159/5351 corresponding RS plot No. 7459 and 0.20 acres of the southern side of CS and -SA plot No. 5159 corresponding RS 7460. It may be mentioned that RS plot No. 7460 and 7459 are in paralal line i.e. side by side and purchased 0.30 acres lands of respondents were in the southern side in one compact i.e. 0.20 acres of RS plot No. 7460 and 0.10 acres of RS plot No. 7459. Respondent No. 1 and his father Abdullah after their purchase developed their purchased 0.30 acres by filling earth, constructed boundary wall and also constructed temporary structures on it. They opened separate mutation Khatian No. 2034/2 and holding No. 3901 in the name of respondent No. 1 on 12-1-1981 and separate mutation Khatian No. 2034/4 holding No. 3903 in the name of purchaser Abdullah vide order of same date, paid land development tax to the Government. 

 11. Another registered partition deed No. 21974 dated 22-12-1982 was executed between the heirs of Jion Box in which entire aforesaid 0.78 acres was in the share of Sayedur Rahman, vendor of respondents. Being owner in his 0.15 acres land purchaser Abdullah gifted 0.15 acres to 4 sons of respondents No. 1-3 and Morshed Alam predecessor of respondents Nos. 4-6 and delivered possession. As such respondents have been possessing aforesaid 0.30 acres land. In last city survey aforesaid land of respondents were recorded in city survey plot No. 37161 with an area of 2924 Ojutangsha in draft Khatian No. 37111 in the name of respondents Nos. 1-3 and Morshed Alam predecessor of respondents Nos. 4-6. Later it was in their name in attested Khatian in 1999 and respondents got draft Khatian in their names. When printed Khatian published it was found that it was fraudulently printed in the name of present appellant Shamsul Alam and on query it was found that he managed to file objection case beyond knowledge of respondents and by suppression of process he managed to obtain order for record in his name behind the back of respondents. It was also found that appellant No. 3 managed to open mutation Khatian in his name for 0.20 acres land of SA plot No. 5159 corresponding RS plot No. 7460 on 25-4-2005 without serving any notice on respondents. Having scent of it, respondents filed Miscellaneous Case No. 19 of 2008 before Assistant Commissioner (Land) Demra for cancelling the said fraudulent Khatian published in the name of appellant which was ultimately allowed on contest. 

 19. It appears that during the pendency of the Artha Rin Execution Case No. 14 of 2009 the judgment-debtor, present appellant filed Title Suit No. 193 of 2012 on 23-2-2012 before the Joint District Judge, Fourth Court, Dhaka praying for a declaration and recovery of khan possession of the suit land against the present respondent Nos. 1-6 claiming that he was dispossessed from the suit by this defendant-respondent on 24-5-2010. The appellant suppressed about filing of the said suit both in the execution case and also in the present appeal. Respondent Nos. 1-6 have knowledge about the aforesaid suit, where they appeared and filed written statement on 17-2-2014. It further appears that the present appellant mutated the suit land by filing Mutation Case No. 4170 of 2005 having came to learn that appellant of present appeal filed Miscellaneous Case No. 19 of 2008 before the Assistant Commissioner (Land) Demra, Dhaka. After contesting hearing the mutated khatian in the name of the appellant was restored by order dated 27-4-2011. Subsequently, in Mohanagar Jarip the name of the appellant was wrongly recorded and against that respondent filed Land Survey Tribunal Case No. 136 of 2008 before the Land Survey Tribunal, Dhaka and same is now pending.
